zh-Hans.text:
宫廷中贪欲盛行
官员私腹日益肥
交易成风。
肥大的刘备身姿
昔日董卓一般。
zh-Hans.author: JohnnySun

zh-TW.text:
宮廷中貪欲盛行
官員私腹日益肥
交易成風。
肥大的劉備身姿
昔日董卓一般。
zh-TW.author: JohnnySun

context.scene: story-event E court corruption and Liu Bei's decline

review_notes: Five-line continuation describing corruption at court, officials fattening private bellies, and Liu Bei resembling Dong Zhuo. The wording uses available B3EJ codepage characters; natural story-screen receipt and final terminology review remain pending.

zh-Hans.text:
不重财利的刘备
停止民间重课,自己
也力行质素节约,
禁止宫廷中浪费。
zh-Hans.author: JohnnySun

zh-TW.text:
不重財利的劉備
停止民間重課,自己
也力行質素節約,
禁止宮廷中浪費。
zh-TW.author: JohnnySun

context.scene: story-event E Liu Bei ends heavy taxation and court extravagance

review_notes: Four-line policy reversal: Liu Bei is indifferent to wealth, ends the people's heavy levies, practices frugality, and prohibits court waste. Natural story-screen receipt and final terminology review remain pending.
